note: GitLab branding area -- renders fixed platform branding and the operator's logo link
global search control -- renders the fixed search interface and keyboard shortcut
create menu control -- renders the fixed create-project action
issues navigation control -- renders the fixed Issues action and its computed count
merge requests navigation control -- renders the fixed Merge requests action and its computed count
to-do navigation control -- renders the fixed To-do action and its computed count
help menu control -- renders the fixed Help action

GitLab project sidebar -- renders fixed repository, issue, merge-request, pipeline, deployment, infrastructure, monitoring, analytics, wiki, snippet, settings, and sidebar-toggle controls; the user-named project header is subtracted
commit search control -- renders the fixed commit-search interface
commit-list toolbar control -- renders the fixed operator-provided commit-list action
commit SHA action control -- renders the fixed copy action
commit navigation control -- renders the fixed commit action link
